sources.creator: Ralph J. Christian / American Association for State and Local History

sources.rights: NPS-hosted nomination. Source text facts used; no PDF images or reproduced pages enter the runtime assets.

method: Period views govern visible character. Later NPS written measurements refine scale, labelled separately. No measurements taken from perspective pixels. Source facts, design choices and unknowns are kept distinct.
